clusters.headline: Kenya: Can Kenya Preserve the Democratic Space Raila Odinga Fought For?
clusters.summary: [DW] One year after the former prime minister's death, Kenyans are reflecting on his contribution to democracy and national reconciliation. Odinga's "handshakes" with his political rivals remain the subject of much debate.

clusters.headline: Lesotho: ALSF And The Kingdom Of Lesotho Sign Strategic Partnership Agreement To Strengthen Legal And Technical Support
clusters.summary: [InfoWire] The African Legal Support Facility (''ALSF'') and the Kingdom of Lesotho signed a Strategic Partnership Agreement (''SPA'') on 21 September 2026, providing a structured framework for ALSF's future legal and technical assistance to the Government of Lesotho.

clusters.headline: Philanthropy can help bridge gaps as AI and climate change reshape societies, says Philanthropy Asia Alliance chief
clusters.summary: The Tsinghua-Philanthropy Asia Alliance Impact Summit brought together leaders from philanthropy, business, government and academia to explore how innovation and collaboration can help tackle challenges.

clusters.headline: Philippines eyes billions in investment from Pax Silica tech hub, but farmers fear for their livelihoods
clusters.summary: A proposed industrial park in Tarlac province under the United States-led Pax Silica initiative could create thousands of jobs, but residents and experts are raising concerns over transparency, displacement and pressure on resources.
